headline: SEEDPIN batches 3+4: thirteen more arcade worlds replayable from a feedback report
lede: Two batches landed on the seed-pinning rollout (#1473): thirteen classic titles now report the seed of the exact world you were playing when you filed feedback — and honor ?seed=N so the run replays tick for tick. Thirty titles in total are now report+pin.

notes.text: Batch 3 recovered a dead lane's unpushed commit and shipped Outpost, BlobBattle (offline) and PapersPleaseMin — then batch 4 wired Arkanoid, BubbleBobble, DigDug, OutRun, MarbleMadness and MagicCarpet to the same contract, raising the feedbackcheck floor to 30 with mutant proof.

A parallel takeover pass merged an empty PR today (#1478 was a stale branch with nothing new) — caught by content-verifying main after merge, superseded by #1479, no harm; the fix (verify head sha before merging) is now written into STATE.md.
MagicCarpet's world used to seed from the wall clock — ?seed=N now outranks the clock, so a filed report of a great carpet run is an exact replay.
